title: cloezia artensis
intro: Cloezia artensis, commonly known as the Tahina, is a flowering plant species found in Madagascar. It has been reported to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cloezia artensis include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, neurodegenerative diseases, and its potential role in treating cancer. The bioactive constituents of the plant have been identified as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
